mechanism_audit.java_lifecycle: LifeLine.addSegmentVariation appends one ordinate-based variation stream in preparation order, rejects lower ordinates and opposite types at the same ordinate, and immediately updates one Stairs instance. LivingParticipantBox consumers query that same LifeLine.
mechanism_audit.rust_lifecycle_gap: e490ea6f introduces SequenceDepthSnapshots for pre-layout spacing and separately builds SequenceLifeLines after event ordinates exist. Both replay raw events, maintain their own return_stack and accepted_events, and independently encode projection keys. That violates review-6-response.md acceptance criterion 4's requirement for one accepted lifecycle timeline. The auto-return held-out failure demonstrates observable disagreement in activation ownership and closure.
mechanism_audit.java_horizontal: DrawableSetInitializer.prepareMissingSpace iterates every concrete GraphicalElement once, uses each element's starting X and preferred/actual width, pushes the shared constraint set for left missing space, and derives final freeX from the same pass. InGroupablesStack registers each concrete element with every active InGroupableList, so nested frames derive from actual members.
mechanism_audit.rust_horizontal_gap: e490ea6f still computes left missing space from a dedicated left-note scan, then separately computes max_divider_right, max_note_right, max_ref_right, max_lost_right, GroupAccum frame extrema, open-group width, and a post-frame svg_width maximum. There is no typed collection equivalent to drawableSet.getAllGraphicalElements and no single prepareMissingSpace pass. The grouped external-arrow, nested-frame, note, and divider failures are direct consequences.
mechanism_audit.acceptance_gap: The implementation fails 7 of the 17 review7 cases that review-6-response.md explicitly requires to pass, and fails 7 of 8 fresh valid held-outs.

anti_overfit_audit.skeptical_assessment: There is no evidence of direct fixture-keyed cheating. The risk is structural overfitting by accumulation of consumer-specific formulas: several scans and topology branches reproduce known cases without porting Java's shared graphical-element and constraint model. Passing all historical/review6 cases while seven known review7 and seven fresh cases fail is the expected signature of that incomplete model.

verdict.reason: e490ea6f does not implement one accepted lifecycle history or one shared horizontal graphical-element envelope, does not satisfy its stated review7 acceptance matrix, and fails seven of eight fresh valid perturbations.
required_model_change: Derive spacing snapshots from the same accepted variation object used for ordinate-based lifeline segments; do not replay events into a second return stack.
Represent notes, messages, external arrows, grouping elements, references, and dividers as concrete horizontal elements with starting/preferred/actual extents.
Register each concrete element with every active nested group and run one two-sided missing-space solve before frame, divider, external-arrow, and canvas geometry are consumed.
Retain all failing review7 and review8 inputs as executable counterexamples.
